Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District’s “Student and Staff Computing Devices” bid (JA-207652; SOURCING #168884; 00004079100) lists 50,000 each of two student Chromebook models and student tablets; 5,000 student Windows laptops; 10,000 each of two staff laptop tiers; and 5,000 each of two staff desktop tiers and two monitor types. Bids were due July 9, 2024, at 2:00 PM CST; electronic submission through iSupplier was preferred, sealed paper submissions were permitted, and fax or email submissions were not accepted. The proposed term was three years, with two successive one-year extensions by mutual consent, not to exceed five years; the listed cooperatives were EPCNT and CTPA. Required deployment services included software installation, asset tagging and reporting, etching on laptops, device setup, and delivery to varied locations. Required documentation included completed M/WBE forms, a signed W9, applicable Form 1295, acknowledged addenda, and a detailed shipment-tracking and deployment plan. Prime vendors must pay subcontractor, supplier, or entity invoices, including retainage, within 10 days of receiving district payment and submit an M/WBE Pay Activity Report with each pay application or as requested, along with required proof of payments.

Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop: Enterprise management ready; Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent; minimum 14" diagonal non-touch display; 720p minimum camera; 1920-1080 screen resolution; minimum 8GB DDR5; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Type C, 65W power supply; minimum 10 hours battery life; minimum 2 USB 3.0, 1 Type C, 65HDMI, and headphone/microphone combo; 128 GB eMMC; Chrome O/S license required; 1-year minimum warranty.
Tier 1 Staff Basic Desktop: Enterprise management ready with Autopilot Enrollment; Intel i5 Processor, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 23.8" diagonal touchscreen; minimum 16GB RAM; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; minimum 3 USB 3.0, 2 USB-C1 HDMI, and headphone/microphone combo; 512 GB NVMe SSD; Windows 11 Pro; 3-year minimum warranty.
Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktop: Enterprise management ready; Intel i7 Processor, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 23.8" diagonal touchscreen; minimum 32GB DDR5 RAM; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; minimum 3 USB 3.0, 1 USB-C, 1 HDMI, and headphone/microphone combo; 1 TB NVMe SSD; Windows 11 Pro or Mac O/S; 4 GB video card; touchscreen optional; 3-year minimum warranty.
Tier 1 Staff Basic Laptop: Enterprise management ready; Intel i5 CPU, 14th Gen or equivalent; minimum 13" diagonal screen; 1080p integrated camera; minimum 16GB DDR5 RAM; 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; USB Type C, 65W power supply; minimum 10 hours battery life; minimum 1 USB 3.0, 1 USB-C, 1 HDMI, and headphone/microphone combo; 512 GB NVMe SSD; Windows 11 or Mac OS; 3-year minimum warranty.
